nodes.question: How much did the power factor improve for the Fe-Al-Si alloy according to Srinithi et al.?
nodes.answer: The power factor improved from 2.5 x 10^-4 W/m K² to 8.8 x 10^-4 W/m K² for the Fe-Al-Si alloy.
